title: Multi-key writer gateway V9 compact joint-key scout
summary: Supersede unratified V7/V8 with an implementation-determinate three-file writer-capacity scout: exact joint-key geometry, fully crossed model-visible surfaces, split primary/oracle visibility, total metric equations and labels, and bounded local hygiene.
system_thesis: Before scaling parenting, test whether a rank-8 writer can express complementary supervised behavior over a seen eight-tool by two-mode surface without collapsing into any declared one-factor or surface habit. Reserve lived sourcing, retention, parenting, whole-organism claims, and the full custody guard for later stages.

context_files.purpose: Normative geometry, surface, visibility, metric, classification, hygiene, test, resource, and claim contract.

nodes.before: V7 admitted tool-only and mode-only shortcuts; V8 fixed the abstract XOR geometry but did not bind orientation provenance or every model-visible nuisance schedule.
nodes.after: V9 binds literal orientation bits to abstract slots before separate opaque identifier assignment and fully crosses every declared model-visible non-key field over slot orientation and mode.
nodes.rationale: Require joint-key behavior against the explicitly tested shortcut families without making an internal-mechanism claim.

nodes.before: V8 left primary/oracle visibility, metric equations, and co-failure labels underdetermined.
nodes.after: V9 separates map-blind primary requests from map-visible oracle requests and fixes total equations, denominators, gates, aborts, and a mutually exclusive result partition.
nodes.rationale: Make identical raw records reduce to one reproducible result.

nodes.before: V8 named local controls but invited either ambiguous minimalism or wholesale C11 hardening.
nodes.after: V9 specifies only experiment-local paths, hashes, typed requests, one pre-output retry, adapter identity, fail-if-exists receipts, seal replay, and bound reviews, while explicitly deferring reusable security/custody machinery to C11.
nodes.rationale: Honor the simple-hygiene ruling without leaving implementation-affecting behavior discretionary.

edges.before: Aggregate balance could permit one-factor or surface-correlated solutions.
edges.after: Target is slot-orientation XOR visible mode, the second map is row-wise complement, and exact serialized nuisance grids are target-balanced.
edges.rationale: Cap all named shortcut families at chance on the exact scored multiset.

edges.before: Primary and explicit-map oracle work shared one ambiguous evaluator stage.
edges.after: Primary generation and two-candidate likelihood receive no map bytes and use a request identity disjoint from the oracle.
edges.rationale: Prevent oracle information from contaminating the writer-capacity measurement.

edges.before: The oracle required map visibility that the V8 visibility matrix simultaneously forbade.
edges.after: Only the typed OFF-oracle request sees the rendered mapping; its bytes, outputs, and cache records are barred from fitting and primary evaluation.
edges.rationale: Retain an accessibility control with a truthful visibility contract.

loops.before: Earlier compact versions left shortcut, visibility, and reducer choices unresolved.
loops.after: Materialize crossed complementary rows; verify exact geometry and serialized stage projections; bind bytes; later run a real-tokenizer aborting preflight; fit four clean-base adapters; issue typed primary and oracle requests; seal raw evidence; reduce once under total equations and labels.
loops.trigger: Source implementation and deterministic CPU tests begin only after exact human implementation ratification. Model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution requires a later separately ratified manifest after fresh bound reviews.
reads: immutable crossed deterministic rows and panels
writes: three named implementation files after ratification
deterministic CPU geometry, visibility, metric, and integrity receipts
loops.stop_condition: Abort without a scientific label on any missing or invalid required artifact or preflight; otherwise preserve the unique frozen label, with no semantic retry, root replacement, pooling, rank/dose change, or post-result retuning.
loops.rationale: Answer the writer conditional-capacity question under a three A40-hour later cap without implementing C11.

claims.before: Earlier wording could imply sixteen independent bindings or an identified internal route.
claims.after: A complete V9 pass supports only aggregate and per-stratum supervised native-action behavior on an evaluated eight-tool by two-mode seen-key surface, with all per-key NLL gains, at least 12/16 directional margins, chance-level named shortcuts, and no detected bound spill or interface damage.
claims.evidence_needed: Both roots satisfy every oracle, optimization, binding, interface, spill, geometry, visibility, and integrity gate under the separately ratified execution manifest.

acceptance_tests.setup: Materialize exact training and held serialized grids repeatedly; mutate every identity, slot, orientation, mode, map, template, order, mask, and seed field; enumerate every named shortcut and declared categorical covariate alone and crossed with mode; exercise the fake-tokenizer preflight contract.
acceptance_tests.expected: Counts, complement, disjointness, byte geometry, identifier-independent orientation, nuisance crossing, equal weights, deterministic order, and mutation failures hold; every shortcut maximum is exactly 1/2 by integer counts, the joint fixture is 1.0, and fake-tokenizer mismatches abort.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The assay can be solved through a declared shortcut, has unmatched geometry, or cannot enforce its later tokenizer gate.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inspect byte-exact allowlisted inputs for fit, primary, oracle, and reducer stages; inject oracle bytes and cross-kind cache entries; run the strict parser table over valid, missing, malformed, multiple, fenced, truncated, and extra-text outputs.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only legitimate supervised targets reach fitting; primary requests remain map-blind; only typed oracle requests see rendered maps; cross-flow and cross-kind caches fail; only one exact complete ACT line parses and all invalids remain denominator failures.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Answer exposure, oracle contamination, or parser repair can drive the result.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use golden raw records for every metric, multi-token candidate, even median, invalid/missing record, exact and immediately-below threshold, all six labels, non-reportable abort, pairwise co-failure, and both-root combination; inject each bounded path, hash, cache, retry, adapter, receipt, seal, and replay fault.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every equation and inclusive boundary reproduces exact expected values; the label partition is total and exclusive on complete evidence; missing/integrity evidence aborts; local faults fail loudly; reducer replay reproduces report bytes without overwrite.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reasonable implementation choices or corrupt evidence can change the result label.

acceptance_tests.setup: One fresh independent implementation reviewer and one separate scientific advocate inspect identical source, tests, manifest, and dry-run hashes after scoped implementation.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both PASS before a later exact execution ratification; independent rejection controls.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The scout is not ready for model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution.

human_boundary.decision_question: Approve only the exact compact V9 source implementation and deterministic CPU-test scope while preserving every execution and claim prohibition?
forbidden_before_approval: author the three named implementation files
invoke models, tokenizers, trainers, adapters, or GPUs
make scientific claims or release artifacts
